Description

Environmental Scientist

Westwood Professional Services, Inc.

The Environmental Scientist
I will work with a group of experienced biologists and ecologists who provide environmental and regulatory compliance support services to a broad range of clients. This position reports to the environmental group manager and other senior environmental scientists on a variety of environmental tasks including field delineations of wetlands and other waters of the U.S., performing tree surveys, collecting GIS data for analysis, preparing GIS maps and exhibits, supporting stormwater pollution prevention efforts, collecting soil and water samples, construction staking, and construction observation.

Requirements

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

Assist senior staff with field delineations of wetlands and other waters of the U.S.
Assist with Section 404 permitting through the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers
Prepare technical reports
Conduct tree inventories and tree surveys using GPS equipment
Prepare GIS-based exhibits
Prepare stormwater pollution prevention plans and conduct stormwater inspections
Assist in preparing Phase 1 Environmental Site Assessments
Field locate tree protection fencing and silt fence using GPS equipment
Collect soil and water samples for lab testing
Function as support staff to existing business lines (land development and oil & gas)

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

COMPETENCIES

Communication
Take direction and ability to work independently and in a team environment
Self-Motivated
Strong attention to detail
Ethical Practice
Environmental Science
Ability to multitask
Commitment to quality, accuracy, and client service

Skills

Experience with ArcGIS and similar software
Proficient in vegetation and wildlife identification and soil classification
Microsoft office software
Technical writing
Efficient use of time to complete tasks accurately, meet deadlines and adhere to budgets

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITY

This position does not have supervisory responsibilities.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

This job operates in a professional office environment and requires a professional appearance. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, scanners, photocopiers, and filing cabinets. This position also requires working outside frequently.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to use hands and fingers to handle, feel, or operate objects, tools or controls, and reach with hands and arms. The employee is frequently required to stand, talk and hear. Physical ability to hike 5+ miles a day in rough terrain and harsh conditions while carrying equipment and supplies weighing up to 25 pounds

POSITION TYPE/EXPECTED HOURS OF WORK

This is a full-time position. Days and hours of work are Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5 p.m. This position regularly requires variable work hours and occasional weekend work.

TRAVEL

Employee will be required to travel for this position. Travel may be on short notice and distance may vary from local to regional to possible interstate travel

Required Education And Experience

A bachelor’s degree in a natural resource- related field
1-3 years of environmental science experience in land development industry

Preferred Education And Experience

Certified Wildlife Biologist
ISA Certified Arborist certification

Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

jobs.title: Research Data Analyst
jobs.description:
POLIS (IN-POLI-IUINA)

The Polis Center is an applied research center at Indiana University (IU) Indianapolis in the Luddy School of Informatics, Computing, and Engineering. Polis makes data actionable for improving community health, equity, and resilience. We build and use information technology and geographically specific data across a variety of domains and sectors to identify and address our community's most pressing challenges including housing stability, public health, and economic resilience. We are a convener and connector, collaborating with community and academic partners to translate data and research into action. We build capacity in nonprofits, community-based organizations, government, and researchers to use these resources effectively for community good.

From inception, The Polis Center has been guided by core values that include making a difference, collaboration, developing creative solutions to real-world problems, accountability, integrity, respect, and stewardship. We emphasize clarity of roles and shared accountability so that team members can work effectively and independently in service of community based research. Our team is passionate about the work we do, and we love working together. The Polis Center places great value on a positive work/life balance.

The Research Data Analyst performs quantitative and qualitative data collection, analysis, and management in support of community-facing applied research initiatives.This position works collaboratively with faculty, researchers, staff, and community partners to support project planning, data collection, reporting, and project implementation.

Department-Specific Responsibilities

Conducts quantitative and qualitative data analysis using established research methods and analytical techniques
Cleans, validates, organizes, and prepares datasets for analysis and reporting
Produces statistical summaries, tables, charts, maps, dashboards, and other data visualizations that support research and decision-making
Assists with literature reviews, project planning, and interpretation of findings
Supports applied research projects by applying appropriate analytical approaches to meet project objectives
Maintains accurate, organized, and well-documented datasets and supporting documentation
Performs quality assurance and quality control procedures to ensure data accuracy, completeness, and consistency
Documents analytical workflows, data sources, and methodologies to support reproducibility
Identifies data quality issues and implements appropriate corrective actions
Follows organizational standards for data governance, security, and confidentiality.
Collaborates with faculty, researchers, staff, and community partners to support applied research and community projects
Participates in project meetings and communicate project status, analytical findings, and data needs
Responds to requests for research data, reports, and visualizations within established timelines
Coordinates assigned analytical tasks with project team members while managing competing priorities and project deadlines
May supervise and mentor data analysis student workers
Prepares written summaries, technical reports, presentations, and visualizations for internal and external audiences
Presents analytical findings in clear, accessible formats appropriate for technical and non-technical stakeholders
Assist in developing materials that communicate analysis results and community impact
May support applied research initiatives in domains such as housing stability, eviction prevention, public health, and economic resilience, depending on project funding and institutional priorities
Documents analytical methods, maintains organized datasets and supporting materials, identifies and resolves data quality issues, and contributes to the development of repeatable workflows and analytical processes
Communicates findings clearly, responds to project and stakeholder needs, and contributes ideas to improve research practices, reporting, and data-informed decision-making in support of our partners' and the center's mission

General Responsibilities

Performs complex data collection, data analysis, data management, literature research, technical writing, and reporting in support of research project(s); performs quantitative and qualitative data collection and analysis
Ensures quality control of data and reports findings to federal and other agencies
Consults with faculty researchers and research staff and provides input on research project evaluations and research project designs
Writes various technical reports, journal articles, and/or develops presentations to disseminate and share research findings
Performs various analyses to ensures quality assurance of research findings (data quality, reports, etc.)
Represents the department with regard to related research and participates in professional development activities and programs
Mentors and/or provides guidance to students, faculty, or other staff working on research project(s) through training in related aspects of research techniques and analysis as needed; may provide daily oversight to less experienced staff or student researchers
Provides additional research project support as needed

Combinations of related education and experience may be considered. Education beyond the minimum required may be substituted for work experience. Work experience beyond the minimum required may be substituted for education.

EDUCATION

Required

Master's degree (preferably in research-oriented field such as statistics, public health/policy analysis, etc.)

Required

WORK EXPERIENCE

3 years in a related field

Preferred

Experience in a community-oriented organization
Experience working with housing, evictions, or community development data or closely related domains

Skills

Required

Proficient communication skills
Maintains a high degree of professionalism
Demonstrates time management and priority setting skills
Demonstrates a high commitment to quality
Possesses flexibility to work in a fast paced, dynamic environment
Seeks to acquire knowledge in area of specialty
Highly thorough and dependable
Demonstrates a high level of accuracy, even under pressure
Strong knowledge and ability to apply qualitative and/or quantitative research skills
Familiarity with and openness to learn new qualitative and mixed methods
Knowledge and familiarity with various statistical software

Preferred

Ability to translate complex data findings into clear, audience appropriate insights for policymakers and community stakeholders
Demonstrated experience in applied community research projects
Strong GIS skills; knowledge of statistical analysis
Experience with data visualization software and coding such as R and Python
Experience with multiple regression models a plus
Understanding of relational databases and SQL

Our teams empower organizations across the globe to create, secure, and run applications that enhance how we experience our evolving digital world. Role Overview

F5 is expanding its AI Center of Excellence
and is hiring a Specialist Solutions Engineer
with deep expertise in AI, Data Science, and LLM behavior
to support our AI Runtime Security
portfolio.

This is a highly specialized SE role designed to fill a critical gap between customer-facing solution engineering
and internal data science
. The primary focus of this role is to interpret, analyze, and explain AI security testing results
—particularly outcomes from Proof of Concepts (POCs), red-teaming exercises, and runtime guardrail evaluations.

You will act as the AI/ML subject-matter expert within the Solutions Engineering organization
, helping customers and internal teams understand:

Why scanners trigger (or don’t)
The tradeoffs between false positives and false negatives
Model behavior under adversarial or ambiguous inputs
How tuning, thresholds, and policy design impact real-world outcomes

Think of this role as a hybrid between a Solutions Engineer, Prompt Engineer, and Applied AI Analyst
, deeply technical, customer-facing, and outcome-oriented.

What You’ll Do

AI & Data Science Specialization

Analyze and interpret results from AI Runtime Security POCs, including red-team campaigns, prompt/response scans, and inference-layer inspections.
Diagnose false positives and false negatives, explaining root causes in clear, customer-friendly language.
Help define acceptable risk thresholds and success criteria for enterprise AI security deployments.
Partner with customers to refine prompts, policies, scanner descriptions, and evaluation strategies.
Act as the escalation point for complex AI behavior questions during evaluations and pilots.

Customer & GTM Enablement

Partner with Account Executives and core Solutions Engineers during late-stage evaluations and technical deep dives.
Support customer workshops focused on AI testing methodology, evaluation frameworks, and AI risk interpretation.
Translate model behavior and statistical outcomes into business-relevant narratives (risk, compliance, trust, readiness).
Assist in shaping POC readouts, executive summaries, and customer-facing reports.

Internal Collaboration & Enablement

Serve as the bridge between Solutions Engineering, Product, and Data Science when interpreting scanner performance and model behavior.
Help define internal best practices for:
FP/FN analysis
Evaluation datasets
Prompt and policy tuning
Scanner validation strategies

Create internal guidance, playbooks, and examples to raise the overall AI literacy of the SE team.
Provide feedback to Product and Engineering based on real-world customer testing patterns.

Required

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, AI, or a related technical field.
5+ years of experience in a technical, customer-facing role (Solutions Engineer, ML Engineer, Data Scientist, Applied AI Engineer, or similar).
Strong understanding of:
Large Language Models (LLMs)
Prompt engineering and prompt evaluation
Model behavior, bias, and limitations
False positive / false negative tradeoffs in ML systems

Experience analyzing model outputs, classification results, or evaluation metrics.
Ability to explain complex AI/ML concepts clearly to non-data-scientists.

Strongly Preferred

Hands-on experience with prompt engineering, LLM evaluation, or model testing.
Familiarity with AI security concepts such as:
Prompt injection
Jailbreaks
Data leakage
Model misuse and abuse patterns

Experience working with real customer datasets or evaluation pipelines.
Comfort working with Python, notebooks, or lightweight analysis tooling (even if not production-focused).

You enjoy explaining why models behave the way they do.
You’re comfortable living in the gray areas of AI—not everything is deterministic, and that excites you.

As AI adoption accelerates, customers are no longer just asking “Does it work?” —they’re asking:

Is this safe?

The NYISO’s Market Structures department invites applications for a full-time Senior Market Solutions Engineer to join our team.

The Senior Market Solutions Engineer will lead the electric power system model used by the scheduling and dispatch software. The Senior Market Solutions Engineer will develop and apply a working knowledge of the New York State high voltage transmission system and the network model database software to support the NYISO market and security functions. Additionally, this individual will lead the real-time power system analysis, primarily the EMS software applications and BMS software applications, as well as the development and evolution of the Energy Management Systems (EMS) and Energy Market Systems (BMS). Strong Power Systems or Electrical Engineering with power system software and/or mathematical optimization knowledge is desired for this position.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES And RESPONSIBILITIES

Lead the evolution of the Smart-Grid applications software.
Responsible for maintaining EMS and Phasor Data Acquisition and Control systems integration
Ensure integrity of Smart-Grid application software by development and implementation of Business Owner Quality Assurance procedures.
Develop and design Smart-Grid application software requirements to support the ISO PMU application functions in coordination with NY Transmission Owners and neighboring control areas.

Develop and Design software and operating procedures to address special market and operating conditions.
Lead and Coordinate the Energy Market Operation and Grid Operation personals in new Market Design initiative or new Network model projects including the new EMS/BMS platform.

Provide advanced operations and market solutions for NYISO
Provide solution and technical leadership in consultation with vendors

Support and maintain the PMU applications such as stand-alone visualization software and EMS based Voltage Stability Monitoring (VSM).

Provide technical support to Market Validation team to validate scheduling and pricing outcomes in the markets.  
Provide implementation support to the product teams by reviewing requirements documents, reviewing design notes from vendors and developing User Acceptance test plans for deployment of enhancements and new features to production.  
Support external research engagements for the NYISO and actively support research engagements under the direction of Manager, Market Solutions Engineering.

Supervisory Responsibilities

None.

EDUCATION

PhD degree in Electrical Engineering or closely related fields (i.e. Operations Research, Economics, other Engineering disciplines) strongly desired. Master's degree required. Coursework and/or demonstrated exposure to electricity market and grid operations required.

Experience

Five to seven years’ experience in the areas of Electrical Engineering and/or Operations Research with software simulation experience is preferred.
Experience using computer programs such as Energy Management Systems, Security Constrained Unit Commitment (SCUC) and Real-Time Scheduling (RTS), Grid View, GE-MAPS, PROMOD, Modeling Language for Mathematical Programming like AMPL, MATLAB or GAMS is highly desirable.
Strong Python programming skills and a working knowledge of shell scripting and Linux command line is required.
Background in models and databases used in power system analyses, and business experience in electric power systems or wholesale electric markets are desired, or equivalent combination of education, training and experience.

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

None required.

Additional Requirements

Ability to read, analyze and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures or government regulations. Ability to write reports, business correspondence and procedure manuals. Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, vendors, Market Participants and the general public.

Ability to work with mathematical concepts such as probability and statistical inference and fundamentals of plane and solid geometry and trigonometry. Ability to apply concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios and proportions to practical situations.

Ability to apply principles of logical or scientific thinking to a wide range of intellectual and practical problems. Ability to deal with nonverbal symbolism (formulas, scientific equations, graphs, etc.) in its most difficult phases. Ability to deal with a variety of abstract and concrete variables.

Intermediate competency in Windows operating environment using MS Office applications, database spreadsheets, e-mail and internet programs. Working knowledge of UNIX desired.

You will also be expected to respond to all business needs that may require any increase to the regular onsite requirements.

The NYISO takes pride in recruiting, developing and retaining highly talented individuals. In addition to competitive salaries, we offer a comprehensive benefits package and innovative reward programs.

About the Company

South Coast Community Services is a behavioral health nonprofit with over 40 years of history serving individuals, families, and youth across Southern California. SCCS delivers mental health services through county contracts with San Bernardino County and Orange County, managed care agreements, commercial insurance, and school district partnerships (NPA-certified). Our team of 400 includes more than 160 clinicians operating across San Bernardino and Orange Counties and beyond. SCCS accepts Medi-Cal, managed care, and commercial insurance plans.

About the Role

The Senior Data Analyst is responsible for supporting organizational decision-making through the development of reliable reporting, data analysis, and documentation of systems and data structures. This role works across clinical, operational, and financial datasets to produce accurate, actionable insights and maintain a clear understanding of how data flows across systems.

The position requires strong technical skills in SQL and Tableau, along with the ability to work with complex relational data environments, including behavioral health EHR systems. A key focus of this role is ensuring data clarity and consistency by documenting existing data sources, reporting logic, and system relationships, enabling more effective and scalable analytics across the organization. This role partners with stakeholders across Marketing, Customer Care, Finance, Clinical Operations, and IT to deliver reporting and analysis that supports day-to-day operations and ongoing performance improvement.

Responsibilities

Data Analysis and Reporting

Develop, maintain, and enhance Tableau dashboards and reports supporting referral tracking, intake performance, clinician activity, and program metrics.
Write and optimize SQL queries to extract, join, and transform data from complex relational databases.
Produce recurring and ad hoc reports to support operational and strategic decision-making.
Ensure accuracy and consistency of reported data through validation and reconciliation processes.

Data Systems Documentation and Structure

Document current data systems, including data sources, table structures, field definitions, and relationships across systems.
Maintain clear documentation of reporting logic, metric definitions, and calculation methodologies.
Identify gaps or inconsistencies in data structures and escalate opportunities for improvement.
Support the development and maintenance of data dictionaries and internal documentation resources.

Data Quality and Integrity

Perform regular audits to identify data inconsistencies, missing values, or reporting discrepancies.
Partner with IT and operational teams to investigate and resolve data quality issues.
Ensure alignment between source system data (e.g., EHR, CRM, billing systems) and reporting outputs.

Cross-Functional Support

Collaborate with stakeholders to understand reporting needs and translate business questions into data queries and visualizations.
Support multiple departments including Marketing, Finance, Customer Care, and Clinical Operations with data requests and analysis.
Present findings in a clear, concise manner appropriate for both technical and non-technical audiences.

EHR and Data Environment Support

Work with behavioral health EHR data to support reporting and analysis needs.
Assist in extracting and validating data from EHR and connected systems.
Develop familiarity with system workflows and data capture processes to improve reporting accuracy.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in quantitative fields such as data analytics, statistics, mathematics, health informatics, or related discipline.
Minimum 3–5 years of experience in a data analyst or similar role.
Strong proficiency in SQL, including complex joins, aggregations, and data transformation.
Experience building dashboards and visualizations in Tableau or a similar BI tool.
Experience working with complex relational databases and multi-source data environments.
Demonstrated ability to document data systems, reporting logic, and workflows clearly and accurately.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy and integrity.

Preferred Skills

Experience working in healthcare or behavioral health environments.
Familiarity with EHR systems and healthcare data structures.
Understanding of basic financial or operational metrics in a service-based organization.
Experience supporting cross-functional teams with reporting and analytics.

At F5, we strive to bring a better digital world to life. Our teams empower organizations across the globe to create, secure, and run applications that enhance how we experience our evolving digital world. We are passionate about cybersecurity, from protecting consumers from fraud to enabling companies to focus on innovation.

Everything we do centers around people. That means we obsess over how to make the lives of our customers, and their customers, better. And it means we prioritize a diverse F5 community where each individual can thrive.

Role Overview

F5 is expanding its AI Center of Excellence
and is hiring a Specialist Solutions Engineer
with deep expertise in AI, Data Science, and LLM behavior
to support our AI Runtime Security
portfolio.

This is a highly specialized SE role designed to fill a critical gap between customer-facing solution engineering
and internal data science
. The primary focus of this role is to interpret, analyze, and explain AI security testing results
—particularly outcomes from Proof of Concepts (POCs), red-teaming exercises, and runtime guardrail evaluations.

You will act as the AI/ML subject-matter expert within the Solutions Engineering organization
, helping customers and internal teams understand:

Why scanners trigger (or don’t)
The tradeoffs between false positives and false negatives
Model behavior under adversarial or ambiguous inputs
How tuning, thresholds, and policy design impact real-world outcomes

Think of this role as a hybrid between a Solutions Engineer, Prompt Engineer, and Applied AI Analyst
, deeply technical, customer-facing, and outcome-oriented.

What You’ll Do

AI & Data Science Specialization

Analyze and interpret results from AI Runtime Security POCs, including red-team campaigns, prompt/response scans, and inference-layer inspections.
Diagnose false positives and false negatives, explaining root causes in clear, customer-friendly language.
Help define acceptable risk thresholds and success criteria for enterprise AI security deployments.
Partner with customers to refine prompts, policies, scanner descriptions, and evaluation strategies.
Act as the escalation point for complex AI behavior questions during evaluations and pilots.

Customer & GTM Enablement

Partner with Account Executives and core Solutions Engineers during late-stage evaluations and technical deep dives.
Support customer workshops focused on AI testing methodology, evaluation frameworks, and AI risk interpretation.
Translate model behavior and statistical outcomes into business-relevant narratives (risk, compliance, trust, readiness).
Assist in shaping POC readouts, executive summaries, and customer-facing reports.

Internal Collaboration & Enablement

Serve as the bridge between Solutions Engineering, Product, and Data Science when interpreting scanner performance and model behavior.
Help define internal best practices for:
FP/FN analysis
Evaluation datasets
Prompt and policy tuning
Scanner validation strategies

Create internal guidance, playbooks, and examples to raise the overall AI literacy of the SE team.
Provide feedback to Product and Engineering based on real-world customer testing patterns.

Required

What You Bring

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, AI, or a related technical field.
5+ years of experience in a technical, customer-facing role (Solutions Engineer, ML Engineer, Data Scientist, Applied AI Engineer, or similar).
Strong understanding of:
Large Language Models (LLMs)
Prompt engineering and prompt evaluation
Model behavior, bias, and limitations
False positive / false negative tradeoffs in ML systems

Experience analyzing model outputs, classification results, or evaluation metrics.
Ability to explain complex AI/ML concepts clearly to non-data-scientists.

Strongly Preferred

Hands-on experience with prompt engineering, LLM evaluation, or model testing.
Familiarity with AI security concepts such as:
Prompt injection
Jailbreaks
Data leakage
Model misuse and abuse patterns

Experience working with real customer datasets or evaluation pipelines.
Comfort working with Python, notebooks, or lightweight analysis tooling (even if not production-focused).

Ideal Candidate Profile

You enjoy explaining why models behave the way they do.
You’re comfortable living in the gray areas of AI—not everything is deterministic, and that excites you.
You can balance statistical rigor with practical, customer-facing recommendations.
You’re energized by helping teams and customers make informed decisions, not just “pass/fail” judgments.
You thrive in fast-moving environments where AI technology, security threats, and customer expectations are evolving rapidly.

Why This Role Matters

As AI adoption accelerates, customers are no longer just asking “Does it work?” —they’re asking:

Is this safe?
Can we trust the results?
Are these false positives acceptable?
What risk remains if we loosen or tighten controls?

This role exists to answer those questions with confidence, clarity, and credibility.

Why Join F5’s AI Center of Excellence

You’ll be part of a small, high-impact team shaping how enterprises evaluate, trust, and secure AI systems at runtime
. You’ll work on some of the most complex and interesting AI security problems in the market—while having real influence on customers, products, and strategy.

If you’re passionate about AI behavior, evaluation, and real-world impact—and want to apply that expertise in a customer-facing role—we’d love to talk.

The New York Independent System Operator (NYISO) manages the efficient flow of electricity on more than 11,000 circuit-miles of high-voltage transmission lines, dispatching power from hundreds of generating units across the state.

The New York Independent System Operator (NYISO) applies cutting-edge technology to operating a reliable electricity system, managing competitive markets for wholesale electricity, and planning for the Empire State's energy future. The NYISO’s Market Structures department invites applications for a full-time Senior Market Solutions Engineer to join our team.

The Senior Market Solutions Engineer will lead the electric power system model used by the scheduling and dispatch software. The Senior Market Solutions Engineer will develop and apply a working knowledge of the New York State high voltage transmission system and the network model database software to support the NYISO market and security functions. Additionally, this individual will lead the real-time power system analysis, primarily the EMS software applications and BMS software applications, as well as the development and evolution of the Energy Management Systems (EMS) and Energy Market Systems (BMS). The Senior Market Solutions Engineer will also lead the development and evolution of the Smart-Grid application software. Strong Power Systems or Electrical Engineering with power system software and/or mathematical optimization knowledge is desired for this position.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES And RESPONSIBILITIES

Lead the evolution of the Smart-Grid applications software.
Responsible for maintaining EMS and Phasor Data Acquisition and Control systems integration
Ensure integrity of Smart-Grid application software by development and implementation of Business Owner Quality Assurance procedures.
Develop and design Smart-Grid application software requirements to support the ISO PMU application functions in coordination with NY Transmission Owners and neighboring control areas.
Provide Power System Operations Dispatcher support and Operator training for all Smart-Grid applications such as, ePDC, RTDMS (Server and Client), ePDE and Grid-Smarts.
Develop and Design software and operating procedures to address special market and operating conditions.
Lead and Coordinate the Energy Market Operation and Grid Operation personals in new Market Design initiative or new Network model projects including the new EMS/BMS platform.
Work collaboratively across the NYISO organization (Market Structure, Market Operations, Grid Operation, Information Technology, and Market Mitigation & Analysis departments) in the design and implementation of market product enhancements.
Lead and Coordinate Factory Acceptance or Site Acceptance Testing for new Market Design initiative or new Network Model projects including the new EMS/BMS platform.
Develop a strategy for regression test for new Market Design initiative or new Network Model projects to ensure the correct market outcomes including the new EMS/BMS platform.
Provide direction on software evolution of the EMS, BMS applications and Data Engineering Tool.
Define and lead studies of future market products and technologies by prototyping and simulations, using historical data or other sound technical approaches, to validate the completeness and accuracy of requirements, robustness of the available technology, evaluate the potential market outcomes and consumer impacts, consider potential market behavioral risks and to confirm that all applicable compliance objectives are met by the requirements.
Provide advanced operations and market solutions for NYISO
Provide solution and technical leadership in consultation with vendors
Develop mathematical models for all EMS and BMS projects in the organization
Provide technical leadership to prepare market enhancements in response to the Stakeholders and Regulators
Lead testing efforts of Capacity Market Operations including development of resource adequacy models, capacity auction models, capacity expansion models and capacity accreditation models. 
Support and maintain the PMU applications such as stand-alone visualization software and EMS based Voltage Stability Monitoring (VSM).   
Provide technical support to Market Monitoring, IT Quality Assurance and Stakeholder Service in replying to Market Participant questions for all aspects of Market Solutions Engineering.    
Provide technical support to Market Validation team to validate scheduling and pricing outcomes in the markets.  
Provide implementation support to the product teams by reviewing requirements documents, reviewing design notes from vendors and developing User Acceptance test plans for deployment of enhancements and new features to production.  
Support external research engagements for the NYISO and actively support research engagements under the direction of Manager, Market Solutions Engineering.

Supervisory Responsibilities

None.

EDUCATION

PhD degree in Electrical Engineering or closely related fields (i.e. Operations Research, Economics, other Engineering disciplines) strongly desired. Master's degree required. Coursework and/or demonstrated exposure to electricity market and grid operations required.

Experience

Five to seven years’ experience in the areas of Electrical Engineering and/or Operations Research with software simulation experience is preferred.
Experience using computer programs such as Energy Management Systems, Security Constrained Unit Commitment (SCUC) and Real-Time Scheduling (RTS), Grid View, GE-MAPS, PROMOD, Modeling Language for Mathematical Programming like AMPL, MATLAB or GAMS is highly desirable.
Strong Python programming skills and a working knowledge of shell scripting and Linux command line is required.
Background in models and databases used in power system analyses, and business experience in electric power systems or wholesale electric markets are desired, or equivalent combination of education, training and experience.

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS

None required.

Additional Requirements

Ability to read, analyze and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures or government regulations. Ability to write reports, business correspondence and procedure manuals. Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, vendors, Market Participants and the general public.

Ability to work with mathematical concepts such as probability and statistical inference and fundamentals of plane and solid geometry and trigonometry. Ability to apply concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios and proportions to practical situations.

Ability to apply principles of logical or scientific thinking to a wide range of intellectual and practical problems. At the MBTA, we envision a thriving region enabled by a best-in-class transit system. Our mission is to serve the public by providing safe, reliable, and accessible transportation. This includes attendance, participation, and contribution in local safety committee meetings as needed.

Job Summary

The Project Coordinator plays a vital role in supporting the Quality Compliance and Oversight (QCO) team through the administration, coordination, and execution of cross-functional projects across the MBTA. This position supports QCO by ensuring projects are delivered on time, within scope, and in alignment with organizational and regulatory standards. The role provides essential support in operations, planning, and logistics—including coordinating and attending key meetings, producing meeting minutes, maintaining accurate databases, and assisting with special projects. The Project Coordinator contributes to both day-to-day operational efficiency and long-term quality and compliance goals by managing data, streamlining communication, and proactively improving processes and workflows.

Duties & Responsibilities

Serve as the point of contact for project updates, ensuring effective and timely communication with internal and external stakeholders.
Coordinate and schedule internal and external meetings involving various stakeholders; manage correspondence and present information clearly.
Provide administrative and operational support to project teams as needed.
Assist project teams in identifying requirements, setting priorities, and aligning activities with organizational goals.
Organize and prioritize workload to support project execution; follow up on task completion while seeking guidance when necessary.
Work independently to manage time-sensitive and complex tasks.
Lead the creation and maintenance of key project documentation, including business requirement documents, traceability matrices, and process maps.
Maintain accurate records of meeting minutes, project plans, and status reports with version control and team accessibility.
Prepare professional correspondence, charts, reports, presentations, and visual data outputs using Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and MBTA systems.
Track and report on project milestones, schedules, budget vs actuals, and resource utilization.
Assist in evaluating project status and forecasting activities to ensure on-time and on-budget completion.
Identify risks or issues related to scope, schedule, or resources, and escalate as necessary.
Take the initiative to improve and streamline policies, procedures, and project processes through analysis and documentation.
Promote and support the use of technology and databases to enhance operational efficiency and project tracking.
Support the development and maintenance of databases for ongoing project needs.
Assist in the processing of consultant contracts, professional service amendments, and contractor claims, payment invoices, or change orders.
Submit invoices, requisitions, and financial documentation in a timely manner.
Assist in monitoring contractor budgets and actual expenditures.
Review and analyze monthly invoices and requisitions from consultants and contractors.
Attend off-site meetings as necessary
Follow up on actions required for task completion while seeking guidance as necessary.
Respond to each inquiry, whether from a customer, vendor, or co-worker in a professional and courteous manner.

Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution.

Effective and professional written and verbal communication skills.

The ability to effectively communicate with customers, employees, and vendors.
Excellent customer service skills.
The ability to work effectively with a diverse workforce.

A High School Diploma or GED with an additional seven (7) years of directly related experience substitutes for the bachelor’s degree requirement.
